The World Internet Conference Puts the One-Person Company on a Global Stage

August 10, 2026 · 世界互联网大会 (World Internet Conference)

世界互联网大会 · 直通乌镇 2026 An OPC special track for founders who build with AI

The World Internet Conference announced that the 2026 "直通乌镇" (Straight to Wuzhen) global internet competition — one of the highlights of the Wuzhen Summit — introduces a dedicated OPC (One Person Company) special track for founders and practitioners who use AI to start and run companies. A one-person company, once a niche structure, now takes its place on a global stage.

The 2026 competition theme is "发现未来新势力 共筑数智新生态" — discovering the new forces of the future and building a digital-intelligent ecosystem together. Beyond the five main tracks in digital health, smart mobility, intelligent terminals, smart manufacturing and new consumption — plus scene competitions and an open-source challenge — organizers added something new: an OPC (One Person Company) special track, explicitly framed as serving "teams and talent who make full use of AI to assist innovation and entrepreneurship."

The OPC track is split into three groups and opens its doors wide: employees of tech companies, university and research institute researchers, practitioners across every industry who have adopted and integrated AI, and freelancers. Semi-finalists pitch online, keeping the barrier to entry low for solo builders anywhere in the world.

This matters because it signals something the Moon Bay OPC community has believed from the start: the single-founder company is no longer a workaround or an afterthought — it is a deliberate, AI-enabled way to start a business. Where an OPC once meant going it alone against organizations, today it means going far with the leverage of software, AI tools, and a support ecosystem around you.

The 直通乌镇 competition is produced by the World Internet Conference and the People's Government of Zhejiang Province, and has run for 7 editions — attracting 6,500+ projects from 47 countries and regions, with 36% of its 312 award winners raising subsequent financing totaling over 100 billion RMB. The 2026 Wuzhen Summit is scheduled for November 2–5 in Wuzhen, Zhejiang.

For anyone weighing an OPC in Suzhou Industrial Park, this global recognition is a strong sign of where the model is heading. Moon Bay OPC helps solo founders take that step — from registration and office space to the tax, finance, legal and resource support that makes one-person companies work.
